verdicts.title: On cluster variables of rank two acyclic cluster algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this note, we find an explicit formula for the Laurent expression of cluster variables of coefficient-free rank two cluster algebras associated with the matrix $\left(\begin{array}{cc} 0 & c -c & 0 \end{array}\right)$, and show that a large number of coefficients are non-negative. As a corollary, we obtain an explicit expression for the Euler-Poincaré characteristics of the corresponding quiver Grassmannians.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns explicit Laurent expressions for cluster variables of rank two acyclic cluster algebras and Euler-Poincaré characteristics of quiver Grassmannians, with no mention of d-regular graphs, communication complexity, or minimal rank bounds.
